title: Feel Room
hook: gf-forge track F's test room: every weapon and move against target dummies that break into bones.
prompt: gf-forge track F feel test room (research/rust-engine/PLAN.md §4, not a game for anyone): hello forge's crypt room with target dummies and a weapon pickup cycle, so every weapon and move can be tried in a browser

round.winBy: Nothing to win: break dummies with every weapon and move.
round.loseBy: The time runs out (a dummy never hits back).

rules.summary: Walk the crypt, pick up the scattergun, repeater and blade from the floor, and break the dummies: shots, the quick melee (V), the evade (Shift), reloads (R), keys 1-4.
rules.scoring: +1 for each broken dummy, times the combo multiplier, and +1 for each coin

content.notes: Shooting skeleton training dummies that break into bones; no blood, no people.

accept: each weapon fires with its own kick, light and sound
a dummy flashes, shows numbers and breaks into bones that knock its neighbours down
the evade, jump, quick melee, reloads and switching all work
notInV1: enemies that fight back (forge-ai, track A)
the viewmodel, particles, event lights and hit flash by the renderer (track R): this room draws stand-ins
